items.title: MECH-489 (SD-099) valence-gating retest with decision counted at the override tick
items.note: DRIVER-SIDE instrument repair + the owed MECH-489 valence-gating retest, authored together because the retest is the thing that needs the corrected readout and the readout cannot be validated without a run (chip-20260820-mech489-retest-driver-decision-at-override-tick). SUBSTRATE half already landed 2026-08-20 (ree-v3 775eb55): the post-override decision window now expires unconditionally. THIS entry lands the DRIVER half. DEFECT: the 910-lineage _decision_alignment read the latched agent._orienting_decision once per ENV STEP while the persistence window is denominated in E3 TICKS; select_action returns the held action at agent.py:6546 BEFORE the Component 4/5 block at 8130, so on a non-E3 tick the orienting fields retain the previous tick's values. MEASURED this session (Step 2.5a probe, 40 env steps, seed 7, ON arm): agent._orienting_last_output read non-None on 40/40 env steps against only 4/40 genuine E3 ticks. CORRECTION TO THE PRIOR DIAGNOSIS, and it matters: orienting_override_fired is read off the SAME latched object, so the 910-lineage n_overrides was ITSELF replicated -- it was never a trustworthy denominator. The autopsy's 'set once, synchronously, in the same if _do_out.override_fired: block' is true of the SUBSTRATE VARIABLE and says nothing about a driver sampling the latched LOG FIELD per env step. So 910's 206/42 = 4.90 is a ratio of two inflated numbers (decision latched over the ~5-E3-tick window ~= 50 env steps; override latched over ~1 E3 tick ~= 10 env steps), and the true override count behind 910a's reported 21 is ~2 -- which also means 910a's MIN_OVERRIDES floor of 5 was ~10x weaker than it appeared. FIX: a NON-DESTRUCTIVE SENTINEL tap on REEAgent.select_action, the same idiom as experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py (699/689d instrument repair) -- stamp a private attribute on the current DefensiveOrientingOutput before the call; it is absent after the call iff the orienting block ran and replaced the object (tick() constructs a NEW output at all three return sites, defensive_orienting.py:220/233/330, never a cached one). On a FRESH tick with override_fired the driver increments n_override_ticks and classifies agent._orienting_decision synchronously in the same block -- the decision is counted AT THE OVERRIDE TICK ONLY, yielding exactly n_override_ticks classifications. n_latched_ticks / n_fresh_orienting_ticks are emitted alongside per /queue-experiment Step 3.5 'Sample-size integrity -- latched substrate diagnostics', so the true denominator is auditable rather than inferred from len(rows). Nulling the attribute would also have been safe (verified: its only other reader, the motor-arrest block at agent.py:9239, is inside the SAME select_action call downstream of the 8196 assignment -- no other def between 5839 and 9260 -- and the probe produced bit-identical action sequences with and without the clear); the sentinel is used anyway because it needs no such proof. The tap is armed ONLY around 906b's _observational_run, so its scope matches the per-step log's and the corrected and legacy counters are directly comparable. PRE-REGISTERED READINESS ASSERTION (machine-checked as load-bearing criterion C1): sum(decision_counts) == n_override_ticks EXACTLY, not ~e3_steps_per_tick times it. The legacy per-env-step readout is recomputed on the same run as diagnostics.legacy_per_env_step_readout with realized inflation ratios, so this run MEASURES the defect rather than inheriting its magnitude from the 910 aggregates. SCOPE: valence-gating sub-claim (Components 4/5) ONLY. Trigger-alignment (Components 1-3) already stands fairly falsified per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-910_2026-08-10 and its 910a reconfirmation; its alignment/coupling numbers are still computed on the identical 906b substrate and reported for context (explicitly flagged as latched and NOT corrected, so they stay comparable to 910/910a) but are NOT pass criteria. CRITERIA: C1 above, plus C2 C_decision_alignment_non_degenerate (>=2 of the 3 decision classes non-zero -- 910's bug signature was 0 approach / 0 resume / 206 withdraw). AND over both; a vacuous pass on either forces FAIL. criteria_non_degenerate keys C1 to n_override_ticks > 0 (it would pass vacuously at 0 == 0) and C2 to the readiness floor. POWER: overrides are produced only in the observational eval, which is ~8% of a cell's steps (220 train eps x 200 steps vs the eval segments), so lengthening eval is far cheaper per additional override than adding seeds. EVAL_EPISODES raised 8 -> 48 by module-attribute swap on the reused 906b module, restored via try/finally (eval is ONE continuous multi-segment life per 906b's CONTINUITY REDESIGN, so this is a clean extension, not a semantic change), with 3 seeds. Expected ~19 genuine pooled overrides against a pre-registered floor of 10; below-floor self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, which here would itself be the finding that SD-099 fires too rarely at its shipped defaults to measure its own decision. ARMS / DV SYMMETRY (Step 3 declaration, one per arm): orienting_on is the only SCORED arm; its DV is the class histogram of the resolved decision over override ticks, whose symmetry group is (i) permutation/relabelling of the three decision classes and (ii) any common monotone rescaling of the two z-scored channels -- the manipulation is NOT invariant under either, because with the gate off the DV has EMPTY SUPPORT (no override ticks exist at all), so enabling the gate changes the DV's domain, not merely its value. orienting_off is a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE CONTROL: with use_defensive_orienting=False there is no gate, so n_override_ticks == 0 is forced by construction; per the two-dispositions rule it is scoped OUT of criterion scoring (disposition (b)) and its zero is recorded as a diagnostic rather than dressed up as a criterion it passes vacuously. It is retained because EVB-0610's dispatch contract requires a discriminative pair on >=2 matched shared seeds, and because it is the control making the ON arm's override count attributable to the gate rather than to the instrument. Readiness preconditions are ON-arm only for the same reason. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = resolved decisions per GENUINE override tick. Checked v3_exq_910_..._20260810T004433Z_v3.json and v3_exq_910a_..._20260810T213616Z_v3.json -- both record only the latched per-env-step counter (the defect), neither retained a per-step episode log, and both predate the 2026-08-20 substrate amend. Not recoverable by reanalysis; a run is required. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): MECH-489 run-keyed brake count = 0 (both prior autopsies read a code-bug/instrument confound, not a substrate ceiling). Brake does not fire. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (2.5c) -- recorded, not silently passed. Degrading and on-path: SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action) -- this run IS its validation; SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (e3_selector.py) -- arm-invariant. Corrupting entries whose substrate_paths name a file this driver imports, none on this run's DV path and all arm-invariant in a single-variable ablation: mode-governance-engagement (whole-file agent.py; its own severity_note scopes the live successor defect to the _lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py gate pattern, which this driver does not use); MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass, mel_consumer.py::relative_novelty; its severity_note scopes the risk to experiments consuming relative_novelty -- no criterion here reads any sleep/SWS/novelty quantity); contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; read by no criterion). Not treated as blocking because a whole-file agent.py listing would blanket-block every experiment -- 47 have been queued since 2026-08-10 on that same path -- so the module-level match is read as a screening flag and the disposition turns on whether the defect is on this run's DV path. Flagged here for any later autopsy. PROGRESS-INSTRUMENTATION FIX inherited from 910a: the reused 906b run_seed already emits one 'verdict:' line per cell, and 910a added a SECOND, so its 4 cells printed 8 verdict lines against a declared seeds=2 x conditions=2 = 4, driving the runner's overall_pct() past 100%. This driver prints no verdict line of its own -- confirmed 2 lines for the 1-seed x 2-arm dry-run, so 6 at full scale = declared seeds(3) x conditions(2). SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK, exit 0, ZERO warnings of any kind (ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT added with the reachability argument stated per-anchor). Three --dry-run passes, all rc=0. The dry-run is itself the first direct measurement of the defect: ON arm 60 eval steps -> n_override_ticks=1 with decision_counts sum=1 (C1 identity holds exactly) while the legacy readout on the SAME steps reported decision_counts_latched_sum=9, i.e. realized_inflation_ratio_decisions=9.0, and n_triggers_latched=9 against n_trigger_ticks=2. Fresh-tick fraction 0.18 (fresh=11, latched=49). OFF-arm control recorded 0 fresh ticks and 0 overrides as designed. z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998, no writer defect. Correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale (preconditions unmet at 60 eval steps), the same expected pattern as 910/910a's own dry-runs. Note the single resolved decision was 'approach' -- the first non-withdraw decision anywhere in this lineage; n=1, so a wiring demonstration only, NOT evidence. ON COMPLETION (for the reviewing session, not done by this queue-time entry): update the SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE second failure_record in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json from 'substrate_half_resolved_2026-08-20 ...; driver half OWED' to a full 'resolved' ONLY once this run has actually produced a bounded counter, and release EVB-0610 / EXP-0035 from blocked_substrate per /implement-substrate Step 8(d). Queued via /queue-experiment from chip-20260820-mech489-retest-driver-decision-at-override-tick.

items.title: MECH-303 behavioural retest (same question as V3-EXQ-939) under a repaired readiness gate: proximity-gated live contextual-safety accumulation lowers background avoidance-commitment (vigilance) release
items.note: SAME-QUESTION RETEST of V3-EXQ-939 under a REPAIRED READINESS GATE, routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-939_2026-08-20 (governance cycle gov-20260821-0203, applied REE_assembly 26891ec7fa). 939's self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue was REJECTED: the gate failed, not the substrate. All three pre-registered DVs PASSED, each clearing the 0.34 margin by ~0.10 with criteria_non_degenerate true, and the designed 2x2 came out clean (A 0.43889 / B 0.0 / C 0.0 / D 0.45, num_safety_steps 240/0/6/240). The run was voided by one readiness precondition missing by 0.0067. MECH-303 stays provisional, pending_retest_after_substrate true; substrate action none; do NOT stamp substrate_ceiling. DOUBLE-COUNTING GUARD (binding): 939 and 939a answer the SAME question and are NOT independent evidence -- they must not both count toward MECH-303's supports. The manifest emits supersedes: v3_exq_939_mech303_proximity_gated_contextual_safety_vigilance_release_20260818T213039Z_v3. THE FOUR REPAIRS (requeue_spec). (1) AGGREGATION: 939's readiness control aggregated arm A's release_rate by MIN while the DVs aggregate by MEAN -- same statistic, so the V3-EXQ-643 rule was met in letter, but the gate was strictly harsher than what it guarded. The floor is now DERIVED, not declared: DV1 = mean(A)-mean(B) and DV3 = mean(A)-mean(C) with mean(B),mean(C) >= 0, so both are <= mean(A), making mean(A) >= DV_MARGIN the EXACT necessary condition for either to clear. READINESS_FLOOR_MEAN IS DV_MARGIN -- same statistic, same aggregation, same threshold, provably never harsher, and no second number that can drift. (2) LATTICE: N_TEST_TRIALS 30 -> 90 (lattice 1/30 -> 1/90; per-seed binomial SE at p~0.44 from ~0.091 to ~0.052 -- the autopsy's 'scale: borderline' finding answered; ~2% more runtime since the test phase is 90 of ~2730 agent steps per cell), AND the per-seed floor is now a FUNCTION of the live trial count, floor(DV_MARGIN*n)/n, so it re-quantises if n ever changes again -- including under --dry-run, where a constant would have been off-lattice against n=6. It rounds DOWN, deliberately: the autopsy's headline finding is that a readiness guard must never be harsher than the criterion it guards, and floor() is the only direction that can never exceed DV_MARGIN. The autopsy's round-UP alternative (11/30) is rejected for that reason. (3) TOLERANCE: N_SEEDS stays 6 and MIN_VALID_SEEDS stays 4, so the tolerance is the one that was PRE-REGISTERED; with readiness moved to the mean it is now the only per-seed guard and BINDS. Reachable-binding witness: three arm-A seeds at 0.30 and three at 0.55 gives mean 0.425 >= 0.34 (readiness passes) with only 3 of 6 seeds clearing the per-seed floor -- 3 < 4, tolerance blocks. (4) CALIBRATION GAP: EXPLAINED AND THE MECHANISM REMOVED. The obvious hypothesis, cross-machine-class divergence, was TESTED AND IS FALSE: re-running the committed 939 driver at its committed constants on darwin-arm64/torch 2.12.0 seed 0 reproduces the ree-cloud-2 (linux-x86_64/torch 2.12.0+cpu) run EXACTLY on every discrete readout (release_rate 0.4666666666666667/0.0/0.0/0.43333333333333335, num_safety_steps 240/0/6/240, total_safety 12.000027656555176) and to ~7 significant figures on the float32 terrain read. Structurally so: the agent's selected action is DISCARDED (the env is stepped with an independent random.randint draw), so the non-portable torch.multinomial draw in e3_selector cannot reach the trajectory. The real finding is worse -- 939's calibration figure (A 0.900 / C 0.000 / D 1.000, terrain 1.235/0.071/2.099) is NOT REPRODUCIBLE FROM ITS COMMITTED SCRIPT ON EITHER MACHINE CLASS. It described a configuration that did not ship and whose provenance was never recorded. Removed two ways: this entry's calibration below is produced BY THE SHIPPED SCRIPT AT ITS SHIPPED CONSTANTS with machine and torch version stated; and the run now RECORDS ITS OWN OPERATING POINT (custom_information.terrain_read_operating_point: per-arm mean/min/max terrain read and its margin over the fixed release threshold), which is the quantity that actually explains the release rate -- 939's arm-A read sat at 0.578 against a 0.5 threshold, a margin of 0.078, which is why ~44% of trials crossed rather than ~90%. Deliberately NON-GATING: it is a proxy for the statistic the DVs route on, and gating on a proxy is the V3-EXQ-643 defect, and its thin realised margin would have become a second way to void a sound run. SUPERSESSION BRIDGE, VERIFIED EXACTLY: trials 1..30 of the 90-trial window reproduce the WHOLE of 939's window bit-for-bit at seed 0 on all four arms (0.46666666666666667/0.0/0.0/0.43333333333333335 vs 939's identical values), because all RNG is reset at cell entry and nothing in the trial loop depends on N_TEST_TRIALS. Emitted per cell as release_rate_bridge_window, so the supersession is an auditable arithmetic identity. NEW FINDING, RECORDED NOT BURIED: release_rate is WINDOW-DEPENDENT. Over the full 90 trials the same seed-0 cells read A 0.7444 / D 0.7000 against 0.4667 / 0.4333 over the first 30; a 2-seed calibration gives arm means A 0.7556 / B 0.0 / C 0.0 / D 0.7611. Not a confound -- the window is identical across all four arms, every contrast is within-context, B and C stay at exactly 0.0, and the DV gaps move UP, away from the margin. But 939a's absolute values are NOT directly comparable to 939's, so custom_information.release_window_profile records per-third and bridge-window rates; shipping a successor whose headline number is ~70% above its predecessor's with nothing in the manifest to explain it would repeat the exact defect repair (4) exists to remove. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4), stated honestly: the decisive readout IS already recorded, in 939's own manifest on substrate_hash a0abd50e06e278f7a7ed551428ffcca9f3e1511781d5a66dc9c6169b77f510d0, and governance HAS recovered it via the zero-compute re-score. What 939 lacks is that answer taken under a correct PRE-REGISTERED gate; its own gate self-routed it non_contributory, so the re-score rests on a post-hoc reinterpretation of a manifest that disagrees with itself. This run supplies the pre-registered artifact. It is also not a replay: arm_cell resets all RNG per cell, so re-running 939 unchanged would reproduce 939's numbers exactly and carry no information -- N_TEST_TRIALS 30 -> 90 changes the config_slice, so every cell is a fresh realisation. WHAT IS UNCHANGED: same 2x2, same arms and contexts, same gate sources and thresholds, same DV_MARGIN 0.34, same DVs and load-bearing assignment (DV2 and DV3 load-bearing; DV1 a config-forced ablation, reported but not load-bearing), same 6 seeds, same substrate config, same phased training, same recording spec. Only the readiness gate, the trial count and the recorded diagnostics change. DV-SYMMETRY (per-arm, V3-EXQ-604c class): the DV is a count of crossings of a FIXED release threshold by evaluate_safety(z_world); each arm's manipulation ADDS to the very quantity thresholded (~accum_weight x num_safety_steps), so it is not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescaling of a rank DV, and not a permutation of interchangeable units -- no arm's manipulation is invariant under the DV's symmetry group. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): recomputed for MECH-303 at authoring time -- count 1, threshold 2, NOT braked. FLAG FOR GOVERNANCE: the single counted hit is 939's own autopsy, which is classified failure_location 'MEASURES FAILED' with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action 'none' (an instrument defect owing no build) but carries recommended_epistemic_category 'standard', so the MOVE-3 counter's instrument-defect carve-out -- which keys on the CATEGORY string -- does not exclude it. Harmless at 1 of 2; it would not be harmless if a further MECH-303 letter also landed non_contributory, since the brake would then arm against the next retest on a reading 939's own autopsy calls false. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP (2.5c): three OPEN 'corrupting' entries name files this driver imports, each disclosed and each argued non-firing. mode-governance-engagement -- use_salience_coordinator defaults False (config.py:3200) and this driver never sets it, so agent.py:682-683 leaves self.salience = None and the SalienceCoordinator is never instantiated; regime_occupancy_gate.py is not imported. MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION -- agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass is sleep; no sleep flag is set and no sleep path is entered. contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy -- the DV reads ResidueField.evaluate_safety and the beta gate, not ContextMemory; scoped to SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166. Open 'degrading' overlaps, disclosed and non-blocking: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (the substrate under test, status_phase validated), SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (predictors/e3_selector.py) and SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action) -- the last two are in the selection path this driver calls and were NOT disclosed by 939. RECORDING: adds enabled_default_off_flags (939 passed only z_goal_stream_stats= to the stamper, which derives that block solely from a live agent=, so 939 recorded no default-off knob provenance at all -- on a run that turns four of them on; computed here by walking each arm's config, at no memory cost, since retaining 24 REEAgents would not fit beside serve.py on the 3.8 GB hub). Carries forward 930's mandated per-tick z_harm_a series + per-seed mean/std and the damage-exposure readout. LABELLING: a readiness failure self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue; a tolerance failure self-routes the DISTINCT label insufficient_valid_seeds_requeue (a robustness failure is not a substrate-readiness failure) -- both non_contributory. The degeneracy_reason wording now states only what the guard found and points the reader at the arm-level numbers, discharging the autopsy's learning #4 (939 recorded 'the mechanism could not express itself, so nothing was measured' while the same manifest contained the 2x2 refuting it). SMOKE PASS: --dry-run rc=0, 8 cells, validate_experiments --strict OK with 0 warnings, 628 corpus-lint contracts green. CALIBRATION (reproducible -- produced by THIS script at THESE constants; darwin-arm64, torch 2.12.0, python 3.13.9, full scale N_TEST_TRIALS=90, seeds 0-1, via a scratch harness so no manifest was written): arm means A 0.75556 (terrain 0.68475) / B 0.0 (0.0) / C 0.0 (0.00076) / D 0.76111 (0.81650); per-seed A 0.74444, 0.76667; D 0.70000, 0.82222. Repaired gate clears comfortably (arm-A mean 0.7556 vs floor 0.34; both seeds clear the per-seed floor 30/90 = 0.33333). Under 939's OWN realised data the repaired gate would also have passed (mean 0.43889 >= 0.34; all six seeds >= 30/90, seed 1 landing exactly on it) -- which is the point.
